title: Remove request body capture from FastAPI and Starlette
author: sentrivana
body_preview:
In span first, we're capturing request bodies on the `http.request.body.data` attribute. Remove this functionality and simplify the code.

Note: this is only about removing the functionality for v2 spans. Old code paths that capture the request body for events should stay as is.

title: Remove extras
author: sentrivana
body_preview: We already stopped adding new extras. We should also get rid of the existing ones in the next major since they can indirectly make folks vulnerable to supply chain attacks if the package gets compromised, which is something that has been happening more and more recently.
